title: Six-Vector Brain Harness Expansion Synthesis: Architectural Seams, Invariants, and Zero-Regression Governance

claims.assertion: Promoting monolithic barrel partitioning (Vector 6) to Phase 1 decoupled 451 re-exported symbols into 7 bounded domains, preventing technical debt compounding during subsequent service registrations.
claims.evidence: src/harness/services/__init__.py reduced from 1,176 LOC to 519 LOC facade; all 7 domain modules in _domains/ stay strictly <= 200 LOC.

claims.assertion: Isolating external heavy engines (PyRIT and HyperFrames) behind lazy subprocess staging and pure-Python simulation fallbacks guarantees rapid, zero-install headless CI execution.
claims.evidence: PyritSubprocessRunner and HyperFramesSubprocessBridge execute clean mocked and simulated suites in < 10s with zero unhandled pipe leaks.

claims.assertion: Pure-Python stdlib implementations for observability (Prometheus) and context optimization (deterministic pruner & Ebbinghaus decay) add zero external pip dependencies while strictly upholding typed IoC micro-kernel contracts.
claims.evidence: All 4 new plugins export instantiated module singletons and co-located zero-fork configs, passing full test suites.
